thread:
elaine (FinOps): Hey team — invoice INV-2054-1123 shows a $6,472 burst charge on 2025-11-02 that looks like it was billed against the customer's reserved commit rather than burst pool. Can someone confirm allocation logic?

owen (Billing Eng): I can take a look. Do you have the time window / meter id?

elaine (FinOps): Meter id: dedicated.prod.pool.us-east-1, window 2025-11-02 03:00-06:30 UTC. Line item shows committed_usage=200k tokens, billed_usage=860k tokens.

raj (Customer Success): This is for KestrelAI — they flagged a surprise charge to their finance team. They were on 1.5T commit.

owen (Billing Eng): Hmm — might be attribution bug when dedicated pool autoscaled and we rolled in burst capacity. I'll query ledger. Running: 

billing-bot: Started job job_11987: run_ledger_query --pool=dedicated.prod.pool.us-east-1 --start=2025-11-02T03:00Z --end=2025-11-02T06:30Z

owen (Billing Eng): Quick SQL I ran:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) as tokens, allocation
FROM usage_events
WHERE pool='dedicated.prod.pool.us-east-1' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-11-02' AND '2025-11-02 06:30'
GROUP BY allocation;
```

owen (Billing Eng): Results: committed=210,450 tokens, burst=649,760 tokens. But the invoice shows committed billed 860k and burst zero. So likely a billing export mapping problem.

maria (Revenue Ops): If that's true we need to fix before sending revised invoice. Do we owe SLA credit from the outage that morning?

elaine (FinOps): There was a regional failover incident 2025-11-02 02:50-03:40 UTC (incident 2025-INC-091). SLA doc says >60min partial outage -> 10% credit on that day's committed spend.

raj (Customer Success): Kestrel raised incident with us at 03:15, they lost throughput. They expect both correction and SLA credit.

owen (Billing Eng): I'll open billing export PR to correct allocation mapping and generate a delta file. Need sign-off from Revenue Ops to apply delta as credit.

maria (Revenue Ops): Approve provisional credit up to $6,500 while we validate exports. @elaine please prepare communication to customer with 'under review' note.

elaine (FinOps): Will do. Draft: "We're investigating an allocation mismatch causing overcharge and reviewing SLA credit eligibility. We'll follow up with a corrected invoice and credit by EOD 2025-11-05."

raj (Customer Success): I'll notify Kestrel and ask for patience.

owen (Billing Eng): Follow-up: found export transform bug introduced in release 2025.10.4 — commit mapping defaulted to 'committed' when autoscale=true. Patch PR 3421 opened.

billing-bot: PR 3421 merged by owen. Nightly export re-run scheduled.

owen (Billing Eng): After rerun the delta shows burst=649,760 tokens moved off committed. Net customer credit = $5,980 + SLA credit 10% of committed day ($520) = $6,500 total.

maria (Revenue Ops): Good — apply credit of $6,500 to INV-2054-1123 and send updated invoice. Finance, please update revenue recognition notes.

elaine (FinOps): Done. Created refund/credit entry: CREDIT-205401-KESTREL-6500. Notified accounting and updated ledger.

raj (Customer Success): Kestrel update sent. They've replied :thumbsup:. Closing loop after they confirm receipt of revised invoice.

elaine (FinOps): Thanks all — reopening if anything else pops up.
